title: Tensor product is right exact
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M_1\xrightarrow{f}M_2\xrightarrow{g}M_3\to0$ an exact sequence of $R$-modules ($\ker g=\operatorname{im}f$ and $g$ surjective) and $N$ an $R$-module. Then $M_1\otimes_RN\xrightarrow{f\otimes1}M_2\otimes_RN\xrightarrow{g\otimes1}M_3\otimes_RN\to0$ is exact; likewise $N\otimes_RM_1\to N\otimes_RM_2\to N\otimes_RM_3\to0$.
